==Overview==
It was contested by 16 teams, and [[Ruch Chorzów]] won the championship.

== Relegation playoffs ==
After the end of the season, play-offs played for two places in the first league in the [[1989–90 Ekstraklasa|1989–90]] season between teams from places 13-14 in the first league and runners-up in the 2nd league groups:<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.mogiel.net/POL/history/polhist.php|title = Ekstraklasa (1st division). History|work=Paweł Mogielnicki's Page|access-date=2020-05-09}}</ref>
* 13th team of the I league and 2nd team of the II league of group II - [[Pogoń Szczecin]] and [[Motor Lublin]],
* 14th team of the I league and 2nd team of the II league of group I - [[GKS Jastrzębie]] and [[Zawisza Bydgoszcz]].

{{TwoLeg start}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[Pogoń Szczecin]]||3–4|'''[[Motor Lublin]]'''||3–2|0–2}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[GKS Jastrzębie]]||0–2|'''[[Zawisza Bydgoszcz]]'''||0–0|0–2}}
{{end}}

Pogoń Szczecin and GKS Jastrzębie did not hold places at the highest league level.
